sql.project.getAllForCompanyProcess: select project.id, company_process.company_id, company_process.process_id, project.customer_id, project.project_name as name from flow.company_process inner join flow.project on company_process.id = project.company_process_id where company_process.company_id = :companyId and company_process.process_id = :processId;
sql.project.get: select project.id, company_process.company_id, company_process.process_id, project.customer_id, project.project_name as name from flow.company_process inner join flow.project on company_process.id = project.company_process_id and project.id = :projectId where company_process.company_id = :companyId and company_process.process_id = :processId;
sql.project.insert: insert into flow.project (customer_id, company_process_id, project_name, created_by_id) values (:customerId, :processId, :projectName, :createdById)
sql.project.getAllForCustomer: select project.id, company_process.company_id, company_process.process_id, project.customer_id, project.project_name as name from flow.project inner join flow.company_process on company_process.id = project.company_process_id and company_process.company_id = :companyId where project.customer_id = :customerId;
sql.project.insertProjectProcessStep: insert into flow.project_process_step(project_id, process_step_id, user_position_id, process_step_status_type_id, created_by_id) values (:projectId, :processStepId, :userPositionId, :statusTypeId, :createdById)
sql.project.getProjectProcessStep: select pps.id as project_process_step_id, pps.process_step_complete_date as completion_date, pps.process_step_status_type_id as satatus_id, pps.date_modified, psst.process_step_status_type as status, ps.id as processStepId, ps.process_step_name as name from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = pps.process_step_status_type_id where pps.id = :stepId;
sql.project.getProcessStepsByProjectId: select pps.id as project_process_step_id, ps.process_step_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as owner, coalesce(pps.date_modified, pps.date_created) as last_updated, p.company_process_id, pps.process_step_status_type_id, psst.process_step_status_type from flow.project p inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.project_id = p.id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = pps.process_step_status_type_id inner join flow.user_position up on up.id = pps.user_position_id inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where p.id = :projectId;
